title: Orphaned resources & cost impact analysis
description: Finds all types of orphaned resources — unattached disks, unused public IPs, orphaned NICs, empty NSGs, idle Load Balancers, zombie snapshots, unused App Gateways/Front Door backends, and empty App Service Plans — in a single consolidated scan.
example_prompt: "Query all subscriptions for orphaned resources: (1) managed disks not attached to any VM, (2) public IPs not associated with any resource, (3) NICs not attached to a VM, (4) NSGs not associated with any subnet or NIC, (5) Load Balancers with 0 healthy backend instances or 0 bytes processed in 7 days, (6) disk snapshots older than 90 days whose source disk no longer exists, (7) App Gateway/Front Door backend pools with 0 requests in 14 days, (8) App Service Plans hosting 0 apps or only stopped apps. For each, show resource name, type, RG, age, and monthly cost. Summarize total waste."
